text_block_list.text:
—New Year's Day. Together with Silence 
Suzuka, we visited a shrine for Hatsumode.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I wished that I can run a lot again 
this year.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I also want to repay Spe-chan for 
looking up to me like she does.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So, this year, without any hesitation and 
with full confidence, I'm going to run as 
much as my heart desires."

I thought it was the same resolution as 
last year, but... over the past year, the 
substance behind it seems to have matured 
greatly.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, I look forward to working with 
you again this year, Suzuka-san! 
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Fukukitaru. Likewise, let's have a 
great year together.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Still... What are you doing with all this 
stuff spread out?

Arranged around Matikanefukukitaru like a 
street vendor's stall were battledores and 
fukuwarai games.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Actually, I was imparted a 
miraculously auspicious New Year's 
fortune-telling method in my first dream 
of the year!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And right over here! We have 3 varieties: 
Oshiruko Fortune-telling, Omikuji 
Fortune-telling, and Fukuwarai 
Fortune-telling!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...What's sweet red bean soup fortune 
telling?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oshiruko fortune-telling reads your 
fortune based on the shape of the red bean 
paste left after drinking it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
For fukuwarai fortune-telling, you play 
the game, and I will tell your fortune 
based on the result!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And for this omikuji fortune-telling, 
we'll be doing a reading based on the 
result of the fortune Suzuka-san draws!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Isn't an omikuji already a fortune to 
begin with...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's a New Year's fortune-telling that 
you can only do right now! Come on, 
Suzuka-san, don't be shy~!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... which one do you think is good, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Bursting with Energy from Sweets! Oshiruko 
Fortune-Telling

Leave it all to fate! Omikuji Fortune 
Telling
Master a new technique! Fukuwarai Fortune

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oshiruko fortune-telling, is it? 
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Truth be told, I was getting a 
little hungry. Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew. Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's divine Suzuka-san's year 
from the shape of the leftover red bean 
paste~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Funnyaka~~ hannyaka~~ Oh, what is that~? 
The leftover bean paste~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It has descended upon me! That is 
unmistakably a horseshoe! The more you 
run, the greater the results shall be~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. That's a good omen. What a relief. 
Thank you, Fukukitaru."

Perhaps she had taken the fortune-telling 
to heart, as she seemed unusually pumped 
up when training resumed the following 
day.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
An omikuji fortune reading, is it...? 
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, I am a little curious about 
what kind of fortune-telling you do.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please take one ticket from that 
box over there~~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I got excellent luck.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Great Fortune, you say!? That is 
magnificent! This is going to be the 
absolute best year~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's just like that, isn't it? Fufu.

Perhaps put at ease by 
Matikanefukukitaru's fortune-telling, we 
spent that day enjoying New Year's in a 
relaxing atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fukuwarai fortune-telling, is it? 
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now then, on goes the blindfold~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Umm, is this... a mouth? Or maybe it's an 
eye?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Even *that* Suzuka-san...! Pfft, 
kukukuku...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
J-Jeez! Fukukitaru, please don't laugh so 
much...! Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"No way...! Nothing matches except the 
nose...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Man, seeing you get confused 
between eyebrows, eyes, and mouth was 
hilarious, Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now let's pull ourselves together 
and move on to the Fukuwarai fortune 
telling!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Funnyaka~~ hannyaka~~ O Fukuwarai, reveal~ 
reveal~~ my fortune for this year~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It has descended upon me! The keyword is 
definitely "bonds"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A major crossroads guided by your bonds 
will soon be upon you~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...'A major crossroads guided by 
bonds'...?

Though half in doubt, perhaps because the 
fortune was unusually specific, Silence 
Suzuka seemed uncharacteristically 
preoccupied by it.
